label: Double effect, causal reading: object not evil, harm not planned, not a MEANS_1, proportionate
term: doctrine of double effect (causal reading of condition 3)
definition: DoubleEffect c: the supplied object classification is not evil (condition 1), the harm is not intended in sense INTENDS_1 (condition 2), the harm is not a means in sense MEANS_1 (condition 3), and intervening costs strictly fewer lives (condition 4). One of two readings of condition 3; neither is privileged here as the classical doctrine.
